story.name: File Upload
story.description: Implement the file upload functionality allowing users to upload PDF, DOCX, or TXT files. This serves as the entry point for the document processing pipeline.

component.name: FileUpload
component.responsibilities: - Drag-and-drop zone using 'react-dropzone' or similar. - File type validation (accept: .pdf, .docx, .txt). - File size validation (max 20MB). - Visual feedback (progress bar, success/error toasts). - API interaction: POST /api/v1/documents/

component.name: DocumentList
component.responsibilities: - Fetch and display user's documents. - Show status badges (uploading, processing, ready, error). - Real-time updates (polling or optimistic UI).

api_endpoint.responsibilities: - Authenticate user (Dependency: get_current_user). - Validate Content-Type (MIME checking with python-magic). - Validate Content-Length. - Generate UUID for storage filename. - Stream file to secure local volume (UPLOAD_DIR). - Create DB record in 'documents' table. - Enqueue background job 'process_document'. - Return 202 Accepted with document ID.

integration.auth: - Frontend: Attach Bearer token from NextAuth session to API requests. - Backend: 'get_current_user' dependency ensures only authenticated users can upload.
integration.async_pipeline: - Trigger: After successful upload and DB record creation. - Action: 'queue.enqueue("app.workers.process_document", doc_id)' - Link to Story 3.2: The worker will pick up this job to start OCR.
integration.security: - File Storage: Files stored outside web root. No public URL. - UUIDs: Prevent filename collisions and traversal attacks. - Validation: 'python-magic' used to verify actual file content matches extension.

validation_notes.alignment: - Frontend: Matches Next.js App Router structure and Shadcn/UI usage. - Backend: Matches FastAPI structure and dependency injection pattern. - Data Model: Matches Story 3.1 and Tech Spec requirements.
validation_notes.completeness: - Security: python-magic and private storage volume are correctly specified. - Async: Explicit link to 'process_document' worker job ensures integration with Story 3.2.
